newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Asian Development Bank to invest in private fund.
newsitem.headline: Asian Development Bank to invest in private fund.

text.p: The Asian Development Bank said on Thursday it will make an equity investment of up to $25 million in Asian Private Investment Company Limited (APIC) and up to $1 million in APIC Management Ltd (AML) to raise long-term capital to finance development projects of member countries.

APIC intends to raise about $500 million from public sources and pension funds in capital-rich countries from North America and other countries and promote private sector involvement in infrastructure projects in the region, the ADB said.
AML will manage the investments of the fund. It will be incorporated in the Cayman Islands and will be based in Hong Kong and Singapore.
The fund is being sponsored by California Public Employees Retirement System and Lombard Investments Inc through Lombard Pacific Partners, the ADB said.
